title: Branching-selection particle systems and inverse first passage problems
summary: A generalised inverse first passage problem asks whether, given a probability measure $p$ on $[0,\infty]$, one can find a boundary $b:[0,\infty]\to \mathbb{R}$ such that the stopping time:\[τ:=\inf\left\{t:Λ\int_0^t ω(W_s-b(s))ds \geq U\right\}\] has distribution $p$, where $U\sim Exp(1)$, $Λ\in(0,\infty)$ and $ω$ is a monotonic decreasing function. We construct a branching-selection particle system whose hydrodynamic limit is governed by a free boundary problem and connect this to the generalised inverse first passage problem.
